question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s position as CCP General Secretary, state president, and Central Military Commission chairman remains firmly consolidated through mid-2026, with no credible reporting of factional challenges, dismissal, or health-related incapacity that would trigger removal before the end of 2026. Trader consensus at 95.5% for “No” reflects the absence of visible elite opposition or procedural signals ahead of the scheduled 2027 National Congress, alongside continued policy continuity and personnel appointments that align with established leadership patterns. Elite politics in Beijing stay opaque, yet repeated past rumors of abrupt transitions have not materialized. Realistic scenarios that could still shift outcomes include a sudden medical event, a severe economic or military crisis prompting elite realignment, or an unforeseen external shock before December 31, 2026.
